steps.content:
20:57, November 26, N.F. 114
A Factory in the West District
In the stillness of the night, the factory stands quiet, save for the faint howls of ventilation systems breaking the silence.
With the impending election, the reconstruction project in the West District, delayed for long, has sprung back to life. This shiny new factory is just the tip of the iceberg.

Not far off, at the central square marked with graffiti and grime, several long-unemployed workers gather. They huddle together, eyeing this rare sight in the West District—a brand new factory—and chatting.

steps.speaker: Syndican Worker A
steps.content: Hey, y'all heard that? The bigwigs are gonna dish out cash to Syndicate!

steps.speaker: Syndican Worker B
steps.content: Nah, that's not it. See that new factory over there? They're lookin' to hire. Had some suits come down here the other day, preachin' about job opportunities.

steps.speaker: Syndican Worker B
steps.content: Heard they're throwin' good money, especially for us seasoned hands.

steps.speaker: Syndican Worker C
steps.content: For real? Since when did they become so generous?

steps.speaker: Syndican Worker B
steps.content: The election's 'round the corner, even Syndicate's gotta roll with the changes. Just look around—fewer gangs on the streets, new buildings poppin' up. My nephew even scored a spot on the Executive Committee last month!
As their chatter continues, a loud explosion suddenly sounded from inside the factory.

Following the explosion, a tearing sound rips through the air. The workers scramble to higher ground, some pulling out their newly purchased terminals, zooming in to get a closer look of what's happening.

In the distance, a sight all too familiar to Syndicans unfolds—billowing smoke and serpentine flames lashing out in all directions, painting the night sky crimson. It seems that some incendiary bomb has been detonated inside the factory.
